quest.title: The Bell of Mourning Echoes
quest.description: A warrior who walks the abyss seeks to carry out an as-yet unfulfilled oath...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x250, Primogem x30, Mora x20000, Hero's Wit x2, Mystic Enhancement Ore x3

dialogues.speaker: Lushne
dialogues.text: We will be in your debt.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Just a moment, if you don't mind! There's something Paimon wants to ask you two...

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You present the items you obtained earlier to the two Lightkeepers. You also tell them about how a strange figure, dressed in Lightkeeper garb, fought by your side to repel the Wild Hunt...

dialogues.speaker: Lushne
dialogues.text: ...Could it have been Sigurd? He hasn't been able to rest in peace, even until now, it seems. If only I could...

dialogues.speaker: Sukhovykh
dialogues.text: Cut it out, Lushne. This is not your burden to bear alone. As long as the Hunt exists, he will continue to fight them. All we can do is to fulfill our mission as best as we can.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Sooo... this Sigurd, he used to be a Lightkeeper as well, right?

dialogues.speaker: Sukhovykh
dialogues.text: Yes. He was a formidable Starshyna, and when the Wild Hunt swept over Nod-Krai, he fought valiantly till the end.

dialogues.speaker: Sukhovykh
dialogues.text: It's said that even mindless beasts flinch when they hear his warning bell, chilled to the bone and too terrified to press onward... And yet, you two somehow managed to recover his relics. How curious...

dialogues.speaker: Sukhovykh
dialogues.text: If you can, please take those relics to his grave. It lies near the eastern battlefield ruins on Lempo Isle.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Will do.

dialogues.speaker: Sukhovykh
dialogues.text: Thank you. May the day soon come when his spirit may rest...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Eh? What's this? Did it belong to that strange guy?

dialogues.speaker: Engraved Inscription
dialogues.text: "Pro aris et focis."

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Return the relics.)

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That guy just now... He was dressed like a Lightkeeper, wasn't he? Maybe he, uh, used to be one...?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Nasha Town's got some Lightkeepers, maybe they know something! Let's ask them.

talks.objective: Head to Nasha Town and look for Lightkeepers to learn more
Take the relics back to Sigurd's grave

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Ready up...)

talks.objective: Take the relics back to Sigurd's grave

dialogues.text: ...The Wild Hunt... permeates...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}, do you hear that? It sounds like...
...Do you pursue the Wild Hunt, or do you hunt with them...?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Leave for now.)

dialogues.speaker: Sukhovykh
dialogues.text: Please take those relics to his grave. It lies near the eastern battlefield ruins on Lempo Isle. May the day soon come when his spirit may rest...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Looks like it belongs to that strange guy...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: This must be Sigurd's grave. It's the only one around, after all...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Anyway... Let's give his stuff back to him, shall we?
